tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: NBA Cup group play, and the Pacers are shorthanded where it hurts most: Tyrese Haliburton is out with a hamstring strain, Aaron Nesmith is questionable with a knee, and T.J. McConnell is only probable after missing the first nine games. The Knicks (6-5) are the better, healthier team against a 4-8 Indiana side, and the line has already moved from -6.5 to -8.5. No price clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number in the game is the Knicks on the moneyline at -307 (-1.6% EV). No true edge, but the lean is the Knicks: the healthy team laying points against a backcourt held together with tape.
games.title: Knicks at Pacers: the shorthanded Cup test
games.verdict: LEAN: NYK -8.5 — no true edge, but the least-bad price in the game and the healthier side.

games.take: Two struggling teams, but the injury report cuts one way: Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain), with Jalen Suggs questionable (knee) and Tristan da Silva questionable (calf) — yet the Magic are still laying 9 at home to a 1-11 Milwaukee team that is 0-5 on the road. That tells you what the market thinks of the Bucks. Franz Wagner has carried the load (23.5 points, 7.9 assists a night) and is the reason our one board play tonight lives in this game. No price on the side clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number is Orlando -335 on the moneyline (-0.3% EV). No true edge, but the lean is Orlando: the home team against the league's worst road record.
games.title: Bucks at Magic: Wagner carries the night
games.verdict: LEAN: ORL -9.0 — no true edge, but the least-bad price in the game and the Bucks are 0-5 on the road.

games.take: The tightest number on the board, and the injury news splits evenly: Giannis Antetokounmpo is probable for Miami despite a right wrist sprain, while Cleveland is without Evan Mobley (toe). Miami's home games have been track meets — averaging 242 combined points across four home games, all above 220 — which is why the total sits at 235.5. The moneyline is a coin flip on our fair number (56/44), and the best prices on both sides sit at about -1.0% EV, so there is no edge to buy. No true edge, but the lean is Miami: the home team, the probable Giannis, and the missing Mobley.
games.title: Cavaliers at Heat: the coin-flip Cup game
games.verdict: LEAN: MIA -2.5 — no true edge; both sides price at about -1.0% EV, so take the home team with Giannis probable and Mobley out.

games.matchup: Golden State Warriors @ San Antonio Spurs
games.take: The headline here is who is not playing: Stephen Curry is out with an illness, and the line has already adjusted — San Antonio is 10-2, Golden State 8-4, and the Spurs are laying 11.5 at home. The total has drifted down from 219.5 to 217.5 with Curry out. Our fair number makes the Spurs an 84% favorite, and no price on either side clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number is actually Golden State on the moneyline at +517 (-1.6% EV), which tells you how little value the favorite's price holds. No true edge, but the lean is Golden State +11.5: with Curry out the points are the only way to play the Warriors, and 11.5 is a lot of points to lay in a Cup game.
games.title: Warriors at Spurs: no Curry, big number
games.venue: Frost Bank Center, San Antonio, TX
games.verdict: LEAN: GSW +11.5 — no true edge; the least-bad price is the Warriors' moneyline, so take the points with Curry out.

games.matchup: Oklahoma City Thunder @ Los Angeles Clippers
games.take: The late game, and the records tell the story: Oklahoma City is 8-4, the Clippers 2-8. The Thunder are laying 7 on the road at the Intuit Dome, and our fair number has them at 70.7%. No price clears our 0.75% bar — the least-bad number in the game is the Clippers on the moneyline at +235 (-1.8% EV), which is the market saying the dog is slightly less overpriced than the favorite. No true edge, but the lean is the Clippers +7: at home, getting a touchdown against a favorite whose price has no value in it.
games.title: Thunder at Clippers: the late-night dog
games.verdict: LEAN: LAC +7 — no true edge; the least-bad price in the game is the home dog.

games.take: Friday night under the lights at Acrisure, and the number has been steady: Pitt -3.5, total 52.5 after opening 54.5. The total coming down two points is the market's read on a cold night — 41°F at kickoff, cloudy and dry, light wind — and two defenses that should keep this in the 50s. Our fair number makes Pitt a 60.9% favorite, and no price clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number is Pitt on the moneyline at -165 (-2.2% EV). No true edge, but the lean is Pitt -3.5: the home favorite in a cold, low-total game where the points should be hard to come by.
games.title: Florida State at Pitt: cold Friday night lights
games.verdict: LEAN: PITT -3.5 — no true edge, but the least-bad price in the game and the home favorite in the cold.
games.weather: Cold and dry: 41°F at kickoff, cloudy, NNW wind 7 mph, ~0% rain. No NWS watch or warning.

games.our_fair: Bruins 78.5% / Fighting Illini 21.5% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: The marquee game of the night: No. 4 UCLA is 9-0 and laying 10 at the Rose Bowl against a 6-3 Illinois team, and the line has moved from -8.5 to -10. The weather is the story nobody is pricing loudly enough — rain is likely through the whole game window (NWS: 80% chance Friday night, a quarter to a half inch possible; 62°F at kickoff with rain building to 55-66% by 7-8 PM PT), and the total has actually ticked up from 46.5 to 47.5. A wet track favors the better, deeper team, and that is UCLA. No price clears our 0.75% bar; the least-bad number is UCLA on the moneyline at -385 (-1.1% EV). No true edge, but the lean is UCLA -10: the undefeated home favorite, in the rain, against a team giving up points it has not earned.
games.title: Illinois at UCLA: the rainy Rose Bowl test
games.verdict: LEAN: UCLA -10 — no true edge, but the least-bad price in the game; the rain favors the deeper, undefeated home team.
games.weather: Rain likely through the game window: NWS 80% chance Friday night, 0.25-0.5 in possible; 62°F at kickoff, light south wind. No NWS watch or warning.
